exclusion_detail: Every compound derives from the Gewald aminothiophenes 1a/1b, which the experimental section says were 'prepared according to the reported procedure' [25-27] with no procedure and no starting materials given; they are not described as purchased, so the route does not start from stated commercial materials.

lead.label: 3j
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 3j (IC50 = 0.498 +/- 0.02 uM) showed the best inhibitory activity comparable to that of donepezil'. (The abstract also highlights 3g for beta-amyloid inhibition; 3j chosen as the one named 'best inhibitory activity', the paper's primary AChE endpoint.)

notes: Lead choice is slightly ambiguous (3g vs 3j); both are ethyl esters from 1b, so the exclusion is the same either way. If 1b were accepted as a leaf, 3j would be 2 steps: 1b + 2-chloropropionyl chloride (AcOH, rt, overnight) -> 2d; 2d + 1-phenylpiperazine (K2CO3, KI, dry acetone, reflux 14 h) -> 3j (55%). 2c (the chloroacetyl ester used for 3g) is itself 'prepared according to the reported procedure [39]'.
